description: Refresh failing-run, effective GitHub-rule and release-entry-point inventories; classify failures and assign resolution owners.
Repair the unit, Tier-1 and infrastructure baseline with behavioral evidence, preserving assertions and exposing any owned temporary exclusions.
Run colocated workspace DB suites, including calendarMonthEndCloseActions.db.test.ts, in CI against migrated schema with required DB availability and deterministic isolation.
Build a runner-derived test inventory that fails for unmatched or moved tests, empty mandatory collection and expired exclusions.
Align workflow triggers and affected selection for dependencies, schemas, harnesses, scripts, services and EE packages; unknown selection widens or fails explicitly.
Publish expected, collected and executed identities and reject incomplete mandatory runs independently of aggregate pass percentages.
Provide a stable aggregate gate that rejects failed, cancelled, missing, empty or unexpectedly skipped mandatory jobs and explains legitimate not-applicable selections.
Require repaired unit, Tier-1, discovery and aggregate checks in effective GitHub protections while retaining existing guards and documenting bypass/freshness behavior.
Remove non-blocking behavior from repaired mandatory infrastructure tests and enforce owned, expiring, visible quarantines outside the critical journey floor.
Provide isolated production-build Playwright smoke fixtures using real sign-in and request identity, with maintainable CE dashboard and representative EE smoke coverage.
Verify Add Usage through the browser with overlapping usage/bucket contract lines, persistence after reload and correct invoice preview.
Verify browser ticket creation, assignment, reply and reopening across persisted state changes.
Verify portal request submission, MSP handling and portal-visible response across separate user sessions.
Verify time logging, submission and approval through invoicing, including refusal to bill unapproved time.
Verify invoice generation and finalization through download with expected invoice identity and amounts, including month-end real-DB hydration.
Verify ordinary technician, portal-client and cross-tenant access boundaries through real authenticated requests for critical journey data.
Retain first-failure diagnostics and report retry-only passes as flaky so they cannot silently satisfy critical release readiness.
Register landed browser journeys as mandatory candidates in the aggregate gate, with Add Usage, ticket/portal and invoicing as the initial floor.
Verify raw MIME intake, queue processing, preserved ticket content, duplicate handling and threaded outbound reply through built email-service containers and a test mail sink.
Define and validate release component manifests; test and promote immutable image digests and reject deployed artifact mismatches.
Upgrade a synthetic existing tenant from the previous supported release schema and validate ticket, usage and invoice behavior afterward.
Run representative EE/Citus tenant-scoped reads, writes and billing against migrated/upgraded schema, documenting topology limitations.
Run isolated post-deploy and scheduled synthetic smoke with safe test recipients, idempotent cleanup, promotion handling and actionable failure notification.
Add versioned execution/journey/retry/edition/artifact metrics without breaking existing Sheets columns or historical readers.
Present readiness, failures, incomplete runs and measured-source inventory explicitly; separate PR/main/nightly trends and version coverage methodology.
Pilot StrykerJS/Vitest on selected billing/date and authorization predicates, review survivors and establish a scoped assertion-strength baseline.
Use fast-check to generate tenant-calendar month-end and DST boundary cases with reproducible minimized failures and DB-backed hydration checks.
Use an independent financial state model for finalize/pay/credit/void/retry sequences, checking balance conservation and duplicate effects against real behavior.
Track escaped defects by journey and missing boundary, linking permanent CI tests to meaningful before/after defect-replay evidence.
Document actual runner/enforcement scope and establish an owned review of escape categories, exclusion age and next journey priorities.
Provide isolated Playwright/algasim wire-level fixtures with reachable provider endpoints on all Alga processes, control-API seed/reset, real callbacks and diagnostic evidence.
Verify invoice payment through simulated Stripe hosted Checkout and signed real webhook processing with persisted balances and duplicate-payment protection.
Verify QBO connection, company/mapping selection and invoice export through the UI with vendor-side readback and idempotent recovery.
Verify Microsoft mailbox and calendar/Teams browser journeys against Graph state; track and resolve or explicitly exclude unsupported SSO and production-override paths.
Verify Xero connection/organization selection and invoice export through the UI with vendor-side readback and correct recovery identity.
Provide representative deterministic provider failure/recovery scenarios, record provider configuration in readiness, and gate landed integration journeys on affected candidates and releases.
Maintain explicit emulator capability and protocol-parity evidence for covered provider routes, auth and callbacks, with unsupported behavior surfaced and optional sandbox drift verification tracked.
